jobs.descriptionText:
The Opportunity
The CTO team is seeking a visionary, hands-on engineering leader to design, build, and scale HSBC Agent Platform as a core capability within the Group AI Platform. This role will deliver secure, reusable and high-performance platform services that enables team across the bank to build, deploy and operate agentic and generative AI solutions consistently, overing orchestration, tool integration, memory, evaluation and governance-by-design. You’ll set the technical direction, drive reliability and adoption at scale and ensure the platform meets enterprise standard for performance, resilience, security and controls.
What You’ll Do
Define the long-term technical vision and roadmap for the Agent platform in collaboration with product management team
Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of a robust, scalable, and high-performance Agent platform
Stay at the cutting edge of AI and agent movement in the industry, and adapt the agent platform to leverage the technical evolving in the industry
Work closely with technology teams across business lines to understand their requirements and ensure the platform empowers them to build agents efficiently
Integrate agent platform as part of the Group AI Platform which spans on-premise and cloud-based infrastructure
Build and manage a high-performing global team of ML SMEs and full stack engineers, to ensure the AI capabilities are built fit for purpose with high quality
Establish engineering best practices, including continuous integration / continuous delivery pipeline workflows, automation testing framework, and monitoring systems for AI applications, and ensure continuous improvement of engineering practices
Implement observability, reliability, and performance optimizations for agent platform in production
Ensure compliance to architecture principle, technical standards, security requirements and software development life cycle controls
Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related subject area
15+ of experience in developing and implementing software solutions, with 5+ years in technical leadership roles.
Hands-on experience in design and development of agentic AI solutions
Proven and deep experience in designing, building, and delivering a large-scale Agent platform
Deep understanding of the agent paradigm, including agent planning, short-term and long-term memory, tool use, agent orchestration and agent evaluation
Experience with high code and low code agent platform
Strong experience in designing and building scalable and resilient platform
Proven ability in building and managing high performing teams of AI SME and full stack engineers
Solid hands-on development skills in programming language such as Java, Python, and CI/CD tools, automation testing, and observability
Proficiency in effective stakeholder management, and capable of effectively articulating AI capabilities, and influencing both business and technology leaders
Experience working in Agile development teams with excellent collaboration skills

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Business: To maximize the revenues of customer portfolio and increase the Bank's share of customer wallets. To maintain a high level of credit quality in the jobholder's customer portfolio and to mitigate the hidden risks of the evolving Banking products.
Assist Associate Director/ Director To
Co-ordinate origination and execution of in country activities across the spectrum of banking products/service.
Build the Banking franchise value/reputation in the market place.
Drive achievement against targets for revenue generation, product alignment, customer satisfaction and cost containment.
Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk.
Identify event driven opportunities on an opportunistic basis, bringing in sector/country expertise as appropriate.
Aggressively grow HSBC's share of client wallet involving product specialists to ensure product capabilities are in line with client/sector requirements.
By critically assessing the exposures of each customer through vigorous review processes, active communications with Customer Service Team (CST) members and frequent update of market intelligence. Such reviews are to be completed on time as required by the account review cycle and also where deemed necessary.
By working closely with Credit Risk Management to ensure that all credits are in compliance of both internal and external requirements and to formulate / implement exit or rehabilitation strategies for substandard credits. The primary goals are to safeguard the Bank for any material loss and to obtain an optimal balance between risk and return.
Customers and Stakeholders: To build effective customer relationships and to become the customers' preferred financial partner and trusted advisor.
By ensuring customers' experiences with the Bank in all front exceed their expectations, i.e. first class services are provided promptly and professionally; solutions presented are competitive and innovative.
By keeping abreast of the customer's business development through frequent contacts in both official and social occasions.
By providing advisory-led value added services to customers with the jobholder's updated sector knowledge and market intelligence.
To assist senior bankers in ensuring focused relationship building programs are carried out regularly.
Leadership & Teamwork: To coordinate the CST to ensure the clients' needs are covered in a proactive and efficient manner. To support the senior bankers in operational issues.
By effectively utilizing customer relationship management tool (i.e. CME).

By working closely with customers to identify macro operating issues and to satisfy their requirements on a regional /local basis.

Good level of financial analysis ability

Provide timely markets outlook as well as FX and Structured Products advice solution and deal placement based on customer financial objectives and needs

负责实现外汇和结构性产品收入预算

增加本部门产品渗透率并为零售客户提供推广数字平台。

Strategy
Support Product Owners in shaping and refining feature scope, backlog priorities, and release plans based on business value, user feedback, and operational needs.
Provide domain input on Banca platform journeys, product configuration, policy servicing, partner integrations, and enhancement opportunities to support platform evolution.
Use client and frontline feedback, production issues, operational insights, and service metrics to recommend incremental improvements to Banca journeys and workflows.
Business
Elicit, analyse, and document business requirements and functional needs.
Analyse end-to-end bancassurance journeys covering product discovery, needs analysis, quotation, application, submission, policy issuance, and servicing.
Capture business rules, product configuration, eligibility, consent, disclosure, document, and integration requirements across markets and insurance partners.
Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business objectives into user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
Conduct impact assessments and support solution design discussions.
Facilitate workshops and stakeholder interviews to understand business challenges and opportunities.
Processes
Support backlog preparation, requirements clarification, and sprint planning activities.
Define test scenarios and support UAT, defect triage, and production validation.

Analyse process inefficiencies and recommend improvements to business workflows and user experience.
Ensure traceability from requirements through implementation and testing.

Identify functional, operational, and control impacts of proposed changes, and raise risks, issues, or dependencies in a timely manner.

Maintain awareness of conduct, compliance, and operational risk considerations relevant to product changes and day-to-day delivery.
Support timely resolution of defects or change issues that may affect user outcomes, controls, or service stability.
Governance

Maintain accurate and traceable documentation for features, enhancements, and testing outcomes.
Ensure delivered changes are aligned with applicable policies, standards, and regulatory obligations.

Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Product Owners
Bancassurance product and business teams
Insurance partners and integration teams
Engineering Lead
Domain Tech Lead
Agile delivery squad members
Business users and stakeholders across bancassurance sales, servicing, and operations workflows
Operations and support teams

Software Product Business Knowledge
Knowledge of and experience with the business aspects and operation of a software product; knowledge of the install base, current uses, future plans, and product vision.
Requirements Analysis
Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
Software Change Request Management
Knowledge of, and experience with, managing product change requests from customers, prospective customers, vendors, and internal staff.
Scrum
Knowledge of the principles, components and features of scrum methodology; ability to apply this methodology to manage software product development processes.
Release Management
Knowledge of activities, practices, deliverables and application release techniques; ability to manage and control the implementation of new or enhanced applications into a production/live environment.
Application Delivery Process
Knowledge of major tasks, deliverables, and formal application delivery methodologies; ability to utilize these in order to deliver new or enhanced applications.

Education
Bachelor's degree, or higher, in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Typically 8 or more years of relevant experience financial services, including 3-5 years in Business Analysis, Functional Analysis, Product Delivery, or Technology Delivery roles.
Strong understanding of bancassurance or insurance distribution, including digital sales journeys, needs analysis, quotation, application and submission, underwriting hand-offs, policy issuance, servicing, and partner integration. Experience gathering and documenting business requirements, user stories, current- and target-state process flows, acceptance criteria, business rules, data mappings, and functional specifications.
Experience supporting Agile delivery teams, backlog refinement, system and integration testing, UAT, defect management, release readiness, and stakeholder engagement.
Ability to communicate effectively with both business and technology stakeholders.

Translate and articulate technical requirements clearly, ensuring alignment between business needs and technical implementation through detailed analysis
Ability to understand system workflows, APIs, partner integrations, data flows, document generation, notifications, and technical constraints, and to collaborate effectively with engineering teams during solution design and delivery.
Experience working with Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, SQL, or similar delivery and analysis tools.

Customer sales and service
职责范围：
客户销售与服务
Key Responsibilities
Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements onindividual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;

Proactively engage with Personal Clients hidden affluent and advise to approach bank with complex investment needs;
Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties;
Ensure compliance of Management Manual, Operating Manuals and Bank’s laid down knowledge of the various products offered by all departments;
Learn and understand all relevant regulations and internal Risk & Compliance policies and procedures;
Keep updated on the events in the financial industry;
Participate actively in training programs, meetings, briefings organized by the bank and ensure skills & knowledge acquired is applied to daily work;
Ensure timeliness & managing customer’s complaint;

理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。
实现领导安排的各个产品的业绩指标；
维护与客户的关系并提供卓越的客户服务以确保满足客户需求；
通过扩大现有客户的投资组合加强客户与我行的关系；
积极参与优先理财/其它银行营销项目，以获取新客户。另外，向现有客户进行交叉销售；
主动发现具有“优先理财”资质的个人理财客户, 并发掘其投资理财需求；
负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
遵循银行的管理手册，操作手册和所有部门相关产品的既定政策；
学习并了解一切相关条例以及内部风险与合规的政策与程序；
保持对金融行业相关动向的敏感；
积极参与银行组织的培训项目，会议和简报会，并保证将学习到的技能和知识运用到日常工作中；
确保客户投诉的时效与管理；
Strategy
Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.
Business
Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates
Processes
Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.
People & Talent
Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.
Risk Management
Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.
Governance
Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
Key stakeholders
List all responsibilities associated with the management of stakeholders e.g. regulators, other bank team

Financial skills
Analytical skills
Qualifications
Selection Criteria:
Full time Bachelor’s degree, or AMAC Fund Qualification Certificate Holder.
1 year or above working experience in financial industry, acting in good faith and professional ethics. Have a good command of knowledge about wealth management sales activities related regulations
Sound knowledge of financial products and services and banking procedures, equities markets, unit trusts and other personal investment services are preferred.
Good investment counseling and analytical skills.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, ability to deal with all levels of people, often in complex and difficult situations.
Team player who shows initiative and assertiveness.
Self-motivator who is keen to upgrade, improve personal knowledge and skills to meet job requirements.
Good command of both spoken and written English and Mandarin

具备良好的投资咨询和分析技巧。
出色的人际关系能力和沟通能力，能在复杂场合应付自如。

Job Summary
Our Insurance Specialists help clients navigate significant life and business changes by simplifying complex insurance solutions to protect and grow their wealth. You’ll conduct fact finding and insurance need analysis for clients and ensure prompt advise and solutions are offered to clients. You’ll execute a systematic review process for existing policyholders.
Our Insurance Specialist will partner with Relationship Managers in achieving the target number of referrals and sales conversion. They’ll provide regular training, workshops and case-studies to deliver on product knowledge, insurance proposition, processes and sharing of new ideas to Relationship Managers.
About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business
We service more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment which encompasses Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.
We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East, and our deep local presence and international network enables us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product propositions span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.
We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within Standard Chartered Group.

Conduct fact finding, insurance need analysis for clients and ensure prompt advise and solutions are offered to clients.
Ensure a systematic review process for existing policyholders.
Work with Relationship Managers in achieving the target number of sales, referrals and conversion.
Train the Relationship Managers via regular training, workshops and case-studies to deliver product knowledge, insurance proposition/pitch, processes and sharing of new ideas.
Generate ideas and action plan on increasing sales activity and other relevant financial drivers.
Skills And Experience
Good in insurance concepts and product knowledge.
Experience in insurance sales is preferred.
Good command in business communication skills.
8+ years of relevant sales experience in a bank.
M5, M5A, M8, M8A, M9, M9A and Health Insurance (HI) certification is preferred.

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
What We Offer
Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
